readme:
# DataForSEO Content Analysis Phrase Trends API

Citation counts, sentiment and top domains over time for a keyword across web content.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/content_analysis/phrase_trends/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/content_analysis/phrase_trends/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "iphone", "date_from": "2026-09-01", "date_group": "week"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keyword` | Keyword or phrase. |
| `date_from` | Start date, "yyyy-mm-dd". |
| `date_to` | Optional end date. |
| `date_group` | "day", "week" or "month". |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/content_analysis/phrase_trends/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.024324 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
